Does The Blood of Dawnwalker Have Character Creation?

Character creator unconfirmed

The official story centers on a fixed protagonist named Coen. A full character creator is not confirmed in the official sources checked.

The confirmed protagonist

Coen is a young man turned into a Dawnwalker who is trying to save his family. This identity is central to the official story description.

Creation versus customization

A fixed protagonist does not by itself rule out cosmetic customization, but the sources used here do not prove a creator or detailed appearance system.

Why this page is intentionally short

A direct unknown answer is more useful than fabricated sliders, classes or appearance options. The page will be expanded only with official or hands-on evidence.

This pre-release page separates official facts from unresolved questions. It will not invent hands-on results before the game is available.
